purpose: Freeze the additional WP2 zero-prompt-full runs and WP3 cascade/parallel runs without changing the active WP1 runner.
result_access_at_freeze: WP1 was running on nafnet/base_seed0; no WP1 fixed-final checkpoint or C009 endpoint result existed.

shared_training.source_bank: Exact immutable C006 D0 bank and train split from the G11 v2 contract
shared_training.fidelity_loss: L1 + gradient L1 + 0.1*detached-weight FFT error on preclip output
shared_training.task_loss: L1 between frozen DeepCrack probabilities of clamped restored output and clean target
shared_training.stream_pairing: same seed uses the exact G11 NumPy stream; final stream hash must equal the corresponding WP1 NAFNet pair

informative_oracle_arm.reason: Architecture, informative prompts, task-enabled objective, data stream, initialization, schedule, fixed-final rule, and seeds are exact-equal.

additional_arm.name: zero_prompt_full
additional_arm.input: degraded channel 0 plus two identically zero prompt maps
additional_arm.objective: The same fidelity plus task loss as informative_oracle; this differs from WP1 base, which has no task loss.

inference_perturbation.evaluation_split: D0 synthetic_holdout only; no training or checkpoint selection
inference_perturbation.shuffled: within each fixed bank-index-sorted batch of 10, cyclically shift the complete prompt pair by one sample

constant.basis: midpoints of the three uniform training ranges

inference_perturbation.mismatch_rule: multiply both correct prompt scalars by the factor and clamp to [0,1]

shared_branch.upstream: Exact clean NAFNet source frozen by G11

cascade.definition: Blur stage receives [degraded,p_b,0]; its selected channel 0 feeds a noise stage receiving [stage1,0,p_n]. Final output is stage2 channel 0.

parallel.definition: Blur and noise branches receive [degraded,p_b,0] and [degraded,0,p_n]. A trainable 1x1 fusion maps [blur_output,noise_output,degraded] to one channel.

wp3.interpretation: The alternatives are matched structural comparisons, not official standalone upstream architectures.

hard_stops: WP1 queue is not complete or any of its 18 fixed-final runs failed.
Any frozen file, source tree, bank, DeepCrack, contract, or checkpoint hash mismatch.
Any additional-run stream hash differs from the corresponding WP1 NAFNet stream hash.
Any pilot fails forced checkpoint/resume, finite loss/gradient, or fixed parameter-count checks.
Any result-based change to the run matrix, structure width, fusion, prompt condition, or fixed-final checkpoint rule.
